children: Ali Behbahani, a Director, reported a direct sale of Common Shares on 2026-09-17. The shares were sold at a weighted average price of $57.0901 per share. The total reported sale amount was $780,935. Following the transaction, Behbahani directly owns 16,637 Common Shares and indirectly owns 29 Common Shares via the Behbahani Trust. The filing notes the shares were sold in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $56.97 to $57.43 and that full breakdowns by price will be provided upon request.
